# AuditOptions.pool property

Settings for the trail's own pool — its size, how long an idle connection is kept, timeouts. Omitted, `pg`<!-- -->'s defaults apply.

**Signature:**

```typescript
pool?: Omit<pg.PoolConfig, 'connectionString'>;
```

## Remarks

The trail writes once per audited statement, so it wants about as many connections as the client it audits; `pg`<!-- -->'s default of ten is more than a deliberately small data pool and doubles what one process holds.
